name: Edict of Mortality
text:
You recite an excerpt of the Laws of Mortality, often the first law: "Let no mortal be beholden to a god." Attempt an Intimidation check check against all enemies within 60 feet that worship a deity, comparing your result against each target's Will DC. Targets are then temporarily immune to your use of this ability for 24 hours.

---
Critical Success The target becomes Frightened 2. Until the start of your next turn, if the target attempts to Cast a Spell with the divine trait, it must succeed at a DC 7 Flat check or the action is lost.

Success As critical success, but Frightened 1, and the DC of the DC 5 Flat check is 5.

Effect: Edict of Mortality
